caption: United States v. McIver
citation_line: United States v. McIver, No. 2:25-cr-00388; appeal, Nos. 25-3573 & 26-1122 (3d Cir. Aug. 26, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Semper denied Representative LaMonica McIver’s motions to dismiss federal assault/impeding charges arising from events during a congressional oversight visit to an immigration detention facility.
qualification_rationale: The prosecution drew sustained national attention and presented a rare, consequential application of the Speech or Debate Clause to conduct surrounding congressional oversight.
appellate_posture_note: A divided Third Circuit panel issued a precedential opinion affirming the denial as to Counts One and Two, vacating and remanding for further consideration of Count Three, and dismissing the remainder of the interlocutory appeal for lack of jurisdiction. Because count descriptions varied in some secondary copies, the signed indictment and orders should be consulted for count-specific practice.
subject_label: Speech or Debate Clause and Criminal Law
